name: voicescribe
description: Voice-to-text book writing application for elderly authors

scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.clean: npm run clean --prefix backend && rm -rf frontend/dist
scripts.kill-ports: lsof -ti:3001 | xargs kill -9 || true && lsof -ti:5173 | xargs kill -9 || true && echo 'Ports cleared'

author: Puneeth Prakash
